title: Didn’t do what I needed. Hard to see where the historic strikes were.
body: Really hard to see the lightning strikes. the icon doesn’t stand out. It’s shows you ‘2 in the last x hours’. Tapping that does nothing to focus the screen on where they were. I know there was one really close to my house at 11:30am today. No sign of it on the map.

title: Pay version may be ok
body: Just downloaded and the free version is clunky and useless. Deleting after posting this. Many other free lightning maps are available. The paid version could be better.

title: Stable code but still unrefined
body: Currently (September 2026) version 1.0.34 still has a fairly crude interface. For example; in settings I am unable to locate the adjustment for display-time persistence on the map. It appears to just use an unknown default time period called “latest” which the developer chose for us. The apparent alternative to “latest” is “past 24h” which does not display any strikes when this option is selected. What it does; it seems to do without crashing which is better than many programs do when they are new and as yet unrefined. This program has good potential to evolve into a go-to program; however it has not yet reached this level.

title: Heads up
body: This program has been helpful with warnings allowing me time to take my radios off line to prevent lighting damage. No burned circuits this summer. Very grateful for that.

title: Ham Station Operator - Good App
body: Monitoring lightening is crucial at a radio station, appears to work well on an old iOS 15 ipad used for weather monitoring. Will likely go premium after a few weeks checking for bugs.

title: Nice and free
body: Helps me decided to golf or not when storms are rolling in fast off the mountains towards Denver
